params.paper: Hempel et al., Toward Robust and Unconstrained Full Range of Rotation Head Pose Estimation, IEEE TIP 33:2377-2387, 2024
params.input: crop 'fsa' (detector crop behind the published 6DRepNet/6DRepNet360 BIWI results: FSA-Net TYY_create_db_biwi.py with image size 256): detector box + 0.4*w / 0.4*h each side, clipped, squashed to 256x256 (cv2 bilinear), RGB, Resize(256) + CenterCrop(224) (test.py), ImageNet mean/std; 6DRepNet360 has no inference/demo code, so this is its only official detector-box pipeline; output rotation matrix -> Euler (6DRepNet utils) -> §0 yaw, pitch, roll (upstream yaw negated)
